services.name: Netflix
steps: Open netflix.com/cancelplan in Safari and sign in
Tap Cancel
Tap Finish Cancellation and keep the email
services.note: Netflix says this page is the only way to cancel. No cancel button = billed by a partner (shown under Membership on netflix.com/account). New Apple sign-ups ended years ago, old ones may still bill via Apple.

services.name: Amazon Prime
steps: Amazon app: tap Account, then Your Prime Membership
Tap Update, cancel and more
Tap Cancel membership and confirm every screen
services.note: amazon.com returned 503 to automated fetches; steps from official help-page search snippets. Several confirm screens with offers. Free trial button says End trial and benefits. Google Play sign-ups cancel in Google Play.

services.name: Spotify
steps: Open spotify.com/account in Safari and sign in
Tap Manage your plan
Tap Cancel subscription and confirm
services.note: Official link is /account/subscription/manage/ (cancel.ts has /account/subscription/, which also works as the plan page). No cancel option = billed by a partner like a phone carrier. Family/Duo members can only leave, not cancel.

services.name: YouTube Premium
steps: YouTube app: tap your profile picture
Tap Purchases and memberships (Paid memberships)
Pick Premium, tap Deactivate or Cancel, then confirm
services.note: If you joined in the YouTube iOS app, Apple bills you: cancel in iPhone Settings. Google lists Android menu names only; iOS label may read Purchases and memberships.

services.name: Disney+
steps: Open disneyplus.com/account in Safari and sign in
Tap Subscription, then Cancel Subscription
Confirm. Cancel before 11:59pm ET the day before renewal
services.note: Direct cancel URL is stated in the official Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Subscriber Agreement. help.disneyplus.com returned empty pages to automated fetches. App Store or partner billing: cancel there.

services.name: ChatGPT
steps: Open chatgpt.com in Safari and sign in
Tap your name, then Settings, then Billing
Under Cancel plan, tap Cancel and confirm
services.note: help.openai.com returned 403; steps from official snippets. If you subscribed in the iPhone app, Apple bills you. Deleting the app or account does not cancel. Cancel 24h before renewal.

services.name: Prime Video
steps: Open primevideo.com/settings in Safari and sign in
Tap the Your Account tab
Tap End Subscription and confirm
services.note: For Prime Video-only plans. If Prime Video comes with Amazon Prime, cancel Prime instead (Edit on Amazon). Channel add-ons can be billed by Apple; cancel those 24h before renewal.

services.name: iCloud+
steps: Open Settings and tap your name
Tap Subscriptions, then iCloud+
Tap Cancel Subscription (iOS 18.4 or later)
services.note: Read via official-domain search snippets. iOS 18 to 18.3: Settings → name → iCloud → Manage Plan. iOS 17: iCloud → Manage Account Storage → Downgrade Options. Over the free 5 GB, sync and backups stop.

services.name: Apple Music
steps: Open Settings and tap your name
Tap Subscriptions, then Apple Music
Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm
services.note: Billed by Apple. Also cancellable at music.apple.com → Account → Settings → Subscriptions → Manage. Downloaded Apple Music songs stop playing after it ends.

services.name: HBO Max
steps: Open hbomax.com/subscription in Safari and sign in
Tap Cancel Your Subscription
Confirm and note your end date
services.note: Help site moved from help.max.com to help.hbomax.com. No cancel option = third-party billing; the provider is shown at the top of the Subscription page. App path (Profile → Subscription) only shows billing, cancel on the web.

services.name: Apple TV
steps: Open Settings and tap your name
Tap Subscriptions, then Apple TV
Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm
services.note: Billed by Apple. Channels added inside the Apple TV app show up here as separate subscriptions.

services.name: Hulu
steps: Open hulu.com/account in Safari and sign in
Tap Cancel next to your subscription
Follow it through and confirm
services.note: Official agreement says go to www.hulu.com/account, log in and click Cancel. cancel.ts uses secure.hulu.com/account/cancel, which no official page we could read confirms. Apple, Google, Amazon or Roku billing: cancel there. Hulu may offer a pause first.

services.name: Google One
steps: Google One app: tap Menu, then Membership plans
Tap Manage plan, then Cancel membership
Tap Cancel Subscription on the page that opens
services.note: On iPhone the app hands off to the App Store page if Apple bills you. Web: one.google.com/settings → Cancel membership. Files stay; you drop to 15 GB free.

services.name: Microsoft 365
steps: Open account.microsoft.com/services in Safari
Sign in, then tap Cancel subscription (or Upgrade or Cancel)
Scroll down and tap I don't want my subscription
services.note: Bought in the iPhone app: Apple bills it, Microsoft can't cancel. Turn on recurring billing showing = already set to expire. Storage drops to free; OneDrive may stop syncing.

services.name: Xbox Game Pass
steps: Open account.microsoft.com/services and sign in
Find Game Pass and tap Manage
Tap Cancel subscription and follow the steps
services.note: Also cancellable on an Xbox console. support.xbox.com pages rendered empty to automated fetches.

services.name: PlayStation Plus
steps: PlayStation App: tap the PlayStation Store icon
Tap the menu, then Subscriptions Management
Tap Cancel under PlayStation Plus
services.note: Web: Account Management → Subscription → Cancel. Access lasts until the next payment date.

services.name: Audible
steps: Open audible.com in Safari and sign in
Go to Account Details, then Membership details
Tap Cancel membership and get past the offers
services.note: Help page needed sign-in for automated fetch; steps from official snippets. The iPhone app can't cancel. Apple-billed memberships cancel in iPhone Settings. Unused credits are lost at the end, so spend them first.

services.name: Paramount+
steps: Open paramountplus.com/account in Safari
Sign in and tap Cancel Subscription
Follow the prompts to the end
services.note: Help page wouldn't render for automated fetch; from official snippets. Apple, Google, Amazon or Roku billing: cancel there.

services.name: Peacock
steps: Open peacocktv.com/account/plans and sign in
Tap Cancel All Subscriptions
Confirm and watch for the email
services.note: Cancel All Subscriptions also ends add-ons. No such button = third-party billing (Apple, Google, Roku, Amazon, Verizon). Cancel by the day before renewal.

services.name: Duolingo Super
steps: Duolingo app: tap the Super icon at the top
Tap the Settings gear, then Manage subscription
Tap Cancel subscription and confirm in the App Store
services.note: Help page rendered empty for automated fetch; from official snippets. Usually Apple-billed on iPhone. Deleting the account doesn't stop App Store charges.

services.name: Apple One
steps: Open Settings and tap your name
Tap Subscriptions, then Apple One
Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm
services.note: Billed by Apple. Ending it cancels all bundled services; keep single ones by resubscribing to them.

services.name: Tinder
steps: Bought in the app? Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Else log in at tinder.com and open your profile
Tap Manage Payment Account, then Cancel Subscription
services.note: help.tinder.com returned 403; from official snippets. Order number starting MK = Apple, GPA = Google, TNDR = Tinder. Deleting the app or account doesn't cancel.

services.name: Canva Pro
steps: Open canva.com in Safari and sign in
Go to Settings, then Billing
Tap Cancel plan and confirm Cancel subscription
services.note: canva.com returned 403; from official snippets. App Store purchases can't be cancelled in Canva. Canva offers a 3-month pause instead. Designs stay on the free plan.

services.name: YouTube Music
steps: YouTube or YouTube Music app: tap your profile picture
Tap Purchases and memberships (Paid memberships)
Pick Music Premium, tap Deactivate or Cancel, confirm
services.note: Same page as YouTube Premium. Joined in an iOS app: cancel in iPhone Settings.

services.name: Nintendo Switch Online
steps: Open accounts.nintendo.com in Safari and sign in
Tap Nintendo Switch Online
Tap Cancel Your Pass by Turning Off Auto-Renewal, Confirm
services.note: Do it at least 48 hours before expiry. Auto-renew can't be turned back on once off. No refunds for unused time.

services.name: Amazon Music Unlimited
steps: Open Amazon Music Settings on amazon.com in Safari
Find the Amazon Music Unlimited section
Tap Cancel under Subscription Renewal, then confirm
services.note: amazon.com returned 503; from official snippets. Apple, Google or carrier billing: cancel there (Amazon can't). Monthly plans may offer pause.

services.name: Crunchyroll
steps: Bought in the app? Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Else open crunchyroll.com in Safari and sign in
Open your account's membership page and cancel
services.note: Article body didn't load for automated fetch; snippets confirm cancel-anytime and Apple route but not current web menu names. The app may have no cancel option.

services.name: Uber One
steps: Uber app: tap Account, then Uber One
Tap Manage Membership, then End Membership
Pick a reason, tap Continue twice, then End Membership
services.note: Cancel at least 48 hours before renewal (US); inside that window you must contact support. Three confirm screens.

services.name: DashPass
steps: DoorDash app: tap the Account icon
Tap Manage DashPass, then Cancel Membership
Pick a reason and tap Cancel DashPass
services.note: Cancel 24h before the next payment. Cancelling a free trial ends benefits right away. A Pause option sits on the same page.

services.name: Walmart+
steps: Walmart app: tap Account, then Walmart+
Tap Manage membership, then Manage next to your plan
Tap Cancel next to Cancel membership and confirm
services.note: walmart.com showed a bot check, not bypassed; from official snippets. Expect a Remind Me Later offer first. Phone: 800-924-9206. Cancelling a trial ends benefits right away.

services.name: Costco
steps: Sign in at costco.com, then Account → Renew Membership
Remove the card set for Auto Renew
Do it 2+ business days before your renewal month
services.note: Online you can only turn off auto-renew. A full cancel with refund is at a warehouse membership counter or 1-800-774-2678 / chat. US site.

services.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
steps: Open account.adobe.com/plans in Safari and sign in
Tap Manage plan, then Cancel your plan
Pick a reason, review, then confirm
services.note: helpx.adobe.com returned 403; from official snippets. Annual plans paid monthly can charge an early-cancel fee after 14 days. Each plan cancels separately. Can't cancel with a failed payment pending.

services.name: Claude Pro
steps: Claude app: tap your initials
Tap Billing, then Manage subscription
Follow the prompts to cancel
services.note: Web: Settings → Billing → Cancel. iPhone-app subscriptions are billed by Apple. Cancel 24h before renewal; account drops to Free, chats stay.

services.name: Google AI Pro
steps: Open gemini.google.com in Safari, tap Menu, then Settings
Tap Manage subscription to open Google One settings
Tap Cancel membership, then Cancel
services.note: Billed through Google One. If Apple bills it, it shows as Google One (or Gmail, Drive, Photos) in iPhone Settings → Subscriptions. Storage drops to 15 GB.

services.name: YouTube TV
steps: Open tv.youtube.com in Safari, tap your profile photo
Tap Settings, then Membership
Tap Manage, then Cancel membership
services.note: URL is the one Google's help page links to. A Pause (up to 6 months) is offered first. Recordings expire 21 days after it ends. Apple billing not mentioned on the official page.

services.name: Hinge
steps: Bought via Apple? Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Paid in Hinge? Open Hinge and tap the gear icon
Tap Cancel Subscription and follow the prompts
services.note: help.hinge.co returned 403; from official snippets. Most iPhone subs are Apple-billed. Hinge now also sells direct via Stripe. Cancel 24h before renewal.

services.name: Bumble
steps: Bought via Apple? Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Paid by card or PayPal? Open Bumble, tap Profile
Tap Subscription details → Manage your subscription
services.note: support.bumble.com returned 403; from official snippets. Deleting the app or account doesn't cancel. Cancel 24h before renewal.

services.name: Dropbox Plus
steps: Open dropbox.com in Safari and sign in
Tap your avatar, then Manage account
Tap Cancel plan at the bottom and confirm
services.note: No Cancel plan button = bought in the app, so cancel in iPhone Settings. You drop to Basic (2 GB) and syncing stops if you're over.

services.name: LinkedIn Premium
steps: LinkedIn: tap your photo, then Premium features
Tap Manage subscription, then Cancel subscription
Follow the prompts and confirm
services.note: Bought in the iPhone app: LinkedIn says cancel it in the LinkedIn app on an Apple device. Bought on iOS mobile web: cancel on a desktop browser. Free trial ends at once when cancelled.

services.name: Snapchat+
steps: Bought in the app? Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Bought on the web? Open accounts.snapchat.com
Tap My Subscription and cancel
services.note: Link only works for web subscribers. Most iPhone subs are Apple-billed. Cancel a trial 24h before it ends.

services.name: Kindle Unlimited
steps: Open amazon.com/kucentral in Safari and sign in
Tap Cancel Kindle Unlimited Membership
Confirm (or pick Pause for a month instead)
services.note: amazon.com returned 503; from official snippets. Some Amazon pages now say Kindle+ (with amazon.com/kpcentral) instead of Kindle Unlimited; check the name. Google Play sign-ups cancel in Play.

services.name: New York Times
steps: Open the NYT site in Safari and sign in
Go to your account's subscription page
Look for the cancel option or ask in chat
services.note: Couldn't tie to an official source: nytimes.com blocks our search and fetch tools, and the help pages only showed up on third-party mirrors, which we don't use. Owner should check help.nytimes.com by hand. App Store subs cancel in iPhone Settings.

services.name: Strava
steps: Bought in the app? Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Else open strava.com in Safari and sign in
Go to Settings → My Account → Cancel Subscription
services.note: The iPhone app has no cancel button; Manage Your Subscription opens the App Store page. Cancel 24h before renewal.

services.name: Calm
steps: Bought in the app? Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Bought on the web? Sign in at calm.com
Tap Settings → Manage Subscription → Cancel Subscription
services.note: support.calm.com returned 403; from official snippets. Family plans cancel only on the website by the admin.

services.name: Headspace
steps: Bought in the app? Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Bought on the web? Sign in at headspace.com in Safari
Open subscription management and tap cancel
services.note: help.headspace.com returned 403; from official snippets. Web subs cancel in a browser, not the app. No button? Email help@headspace.com.

services.name: Apple Arcade
steps: Open Settings and tap your name
Tap Subscriptions, then Apple Arcade
Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm
services.note: Billed by Apple. Arcade games stop working after it ends, even downloaded ones.

services.name: Apple Fitness+
steps: Fitness app: tap Summary, then your profile picture
Tap your account name, then Apple Fitness+
Follow the steps to cancel
services.note: Read via official-domain snippets. Settings → your name → Subscriptions works too. If it's part of Apple One Premier, cancel Apple One instead.

services.name: SiriusXM
steps: Open the SiriusXM Online Account Center and sign in
Tap the Subscriptions tab
Choose cancel, or call 866-635-8641
services.note: Bought in the iPhone app: Apple bills it. Roku and T-Mobile billing cancel with them. Expect retention offers. Cancel 24h before renewal.

services.name: ESPN
steps: Open espn.com in Safari, sign in, tap your profile
Tap Account, then Manage Subscription
Tap Subscription, pick the plan, then Cancel and confirm
services.note: Covers ESPN Select and Unlimited (the old ESPN+ plans). Apple, Google or Roku billing: cancel there. Bundles cancel where you bought them.

services.name: Instacart+
steps: Instacart app: tap the Account icon
Tap Your Instacart+ membership
Tap Cancel membership, skip the offer, then confirm
services.note: Annual plans refund in full only within 5 days with no orders. Costco and NYT Cooking bundles have their own rules.
